claims.text: Formosus had been dead for about nine months when tried in January 897
claims.quote: who had been dead for about nine months, in the Basilica of St. John Lateran in Rome during January 897

claims.text: Stephen VI had the corpse exhumed and brought to court
claims.quote: Stephen had Formosus's corpse exhumed and brought to the papal court for judgment.

claims.text: The corpse sat propped on a throne with a deacon answering for it
claims.quote: With the corpse propped up on a throne, a deacon was appointed to answer for the deceased pontiff.

claims.text: Also accused of illegally presiding over more than one diocese at the same time
claims.quote: illegally presiding over more than one diocese at the same time
Formosus, being several months dead, could not answer.
Eventually, the corpse was found guilty.

claims.text: Three blessing fingers of the right hand were cut off
claims.quote: cut off the three fingers of the right hand

claims.text: The body was buried, dug up again, weighted and thrown into the Tiber
claims.quote: tied to weights, and cast into the Tiber River

claims.text: Public uprising deposed and imprisoned Stephen; strangled in July or August 897
claims.quote: A public uprising deposed and imprisoned Stephen. He was strangled in prison in July or August 897.

claims.text: Rumour said the corpse in the river was performing miracles
claims.quote: rumor had it that his waterlogged rotting corpse was still performing miracles

claims.text: In December 897 Theodore II annulled the synod and rehabilitated Formosus
claims.quote: In December 897 Pope Theodore II (897) convened a synod that annulled the Cadaver Synod, rehabilitated Formosus

claims.text: Later synods prohibited any trial of a corpse
claims.quote: and prohibited any trial of a corpse in the future.

claims.text: Between 896 and 904 on average a new pope every year
claims.quote: between 896 and 904 there was, on average, a new pope every year

claims.text: Boniface VI succeeded Formosus and died two weeks later
claims.quote: who himself died two weeks later

claims.text: The synod is generally presumed politically motivated
claims.quote: The Cadaver Synod is generally presumed to have been politically motivated.
